documentation_excerpts.text: Coverage tells you code was executed. Mutation testing tells you whether the tests would notice that code being wrong. A tool plants one small bug at a time (a mutant: `>=` becomes `>`, `+` becomes `-`, a condition is deleted), reruns the suite, and records the verdict. A test failure kills the mutant. A suite that stays green let the bug through — every surviving mutant is a lie the test suite tells.
